fusions.name: Devouring Cloud
fusions.desc: Hits every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 3 dark damage. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Glut Swoop
fusions.desc: A diving bite that deals 8 blood damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Colony Rising
fusions.desc: Sends out a swarm for 12 seconds that strikes an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every second, each strike with a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Swollen Ranks
fusions.desc: Every kill you make builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you heal for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
